ui.enabled.description: Enable the web UI. When disabled, the web interface will not be served.

ui.show_tooltips.description: Show tooltips in the web UI for additional help.

accounts.enabled.description: Enable basic authentication for the web UI.

accounts.list.description: List of username/password pairs for UI access. Each must be unique and non-empty.

password.description: Password (stored in plaintext in config if not hashed externally)

sessions.enabled.description: Enable session management for logged-in users.

sessions.timeout.description: Session timeout in minutes. After this time, inactive sessions will be discarded.

network.hostname.description: Optional hostname to advertise in UPnP. If empty, system hostname is used.

network.ip.description: IP address to bind the HTTP server to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

network.port.description: HTTP port for the web UI and UPnP control points.

network.udn.description: Unique Device Name (UUID) for this Gerbera instance. Leave blank to auto-generate.

network.home.description: Path to the home directory. Required if not default.

network.webroot.description: Path to the web UI files. Usually auto-detected. Set only if non-standard.

transcoding.enabled.description: Enable external transcoding support (e.g., for video formats unsupported by clients).

transcoding.profiles.description: List of transcoding profiles. Each defines how a given mimetype is transcoded.

args.description: Command-line arguments. Use %in for input file, %out optional for stdout handling

fill_size.description: Buffer fill threshold before streaming starts

db.engine.description: Database engine. 'sqlite3' is lightweight and self-contained; 'mysql' for larger libraries or shared infrastructure.

db.sqlite.path.description: Directory for SQLite database files (gerbera.db, gerbera.tmp, etc.).

db.mysql.password.description: Password for MySQL user. Stored in config file — ensure secure file permissions.

db.options.description: Extra database engine options. Key-value pairs passed to the database driver.

log.level.description: Logging verbosity. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting; 'full' for deep protocol tracing.

log.target.description: Log target: a file path (e.g., 'file:/var/log/gerbera.log') or 'stdout' for console.

export.ext_map.description: Override extension→mimetype mapping (higher priority than export.mimetypes).

container_dircleaner.interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic directory scan for container updates. 0 disables.

custom_metadata.enabled.description: Enable custom metadata extraction rules (e.g., for embedded album art or custom tags).

metadata.description: Tag → XPath expression map. Expression is evaluated on the file’s metadata (e.g., 'ffmpeg.probe').

presentation.url.description: Base URL for the web UI and presentation URLs in UPnP responses.

presentation.dir_order.description: Default sort order for directory listings in the web UI and UPnP clients.

selections.description: List of whitelist/blacklist sections. 'whitelist' restricts scanning to listed paths; 'blacklist' excludes listed paths. Multiple sections allowed.

mode.description: Scan mode: include only or exclude these paths

paths.description: Absolute paths to include or exclude
